title: Evaluate delivered outcomes without repeating acceptance for every small correction
outcome: Independent acceptance checks meaningful delivered outcomes and reuses attributable current-input evidence instead of commissioning another evaluator for each minor implementation correction.
acceptance: Define the evaluation unit and conditions requiring a fresh independent evaluation; routine corrections inside the same delivery do not automatically create separate acceptance delegations.

Demonstrate the simplified flow on small and substantive changes, preserving criterion coverage, evaluator independence where required, changed-input invalidation and honest evidence attribution; update governing contracts together rather than bypassing the active completion policy.
